content.text:
TASK:
Sign on to MERIDIAN CORE as the operator (fill Operator ID, Password, leave Branch as-is, click Sign On). Then open Member Inquiry, search by Member Number for member 100234, and click Select to open that member's record. On the MEMBER RECORD screen use read_table ONCE to capture the whole SHARES / BALANCES table into an output named 'shares', requesting exactly these columns: Share ID, Type, Balance, Status. Do NOT read individual cells. Then probe one exceptional state: begin_probe MEMBER_NOT_FOUND, go back to Member Inquiry, search by Member Number for 999999 which does not exist, and declare_outcome MEMBER_NOT_FOUND with a marker string you can literally see on that screen. Finally declare_done with capability_id 'member.readBalances'.

PARAMETERS:
- memberId (internal): Caller-supplied parameter 'memberId'. — value: "100234"
- operatorId (internal): Resolved from the environment (MERIDIAN_OPERATOR_ID) at invocation time; never stored in the artifact. — value: "teller1"
- operatorPassword (secret): Resolved from the environment (MERIDIAN_OPERATOR_PASSWORD) at invocation time; never stored in the artifact. — value: (secret — reference with param, never typed literally)

The application is served at https://web-sample.interface-hiring.com. The browser is currently blank — begin by navigating to the application.
I'll start by navigating to the application.
